blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recent multimodal language models can reason directly about robot scenes, but it is unclear whether they need to repeatedly reinterpret raw visual observations at every step of an interaction. We propose shifting routine spatial reasoning from images to text and symbols through a 3D geometric abstraction that is refreshed locally from observations and read directly by the language models. Specifically, our interface represents scene geometry via typed, evidence-aware symbolic references to object parts, grounds them from calibrated RGB-D, and returns compact textual checkpoints with metric residuals after each action. Symbolic task structure can thus be reused across decisions while metric values are rebound to the current scene, with direct visual reasoning invoked only on demand. Across offline policy synthesis and continuous online execution, reasoning over grounded text and symbols improves multi-step manipulation completion while substantially reducing repeated multimodal queries, positioning explicit geometric state as an effective substrate for agentic robot policies.
blocks.zh: 近期的多模式语言模型可以直接对机器人场景进行解释,但不清楚它们是否需要在互动的每一个步骤中反复重新解释原始视觉观察. 我们建议将常规的空间推理从图像转移到文字和符号上,通过从局部观察中刷新出来并由语言模型直接读取的三维几何抽象. 具体地说,我们的界面通过打字、有证据意识的象征意义地提及物体部件,使这些部件无法校准RGB-D,并在每次行动后返回带有度量剩余值的紧凑文本检查站。 因此,符号性任务结构可以在各种决定中重复使用,而衡量值则在反弹到目前的场景,只有根据需要才直接引用视觉推理。 纵观离线政策综合和连续的在线执行,对基于基础的文字和符号的推理可以改进多步骤的操纵完成,同时大大减少重复的多式联运查询,将明确的几何状态定位为代理机器人政策的有效底物。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Recent frontier multimodal models have demonstrated increasingly strong 3D spatial reasoning and, in some cases, can directly drive robot manipulation without task-specific policy training [ 24 , 10 , 19 , 17 ] .
However, deploying such models in closed-loop manipulation often requires repeatedly reinterpreting visual observations as the scene evolves, even though many manipulation decisions are governed by a compact set of task-relevant geometric quantities [ 14 , 26 ] .
Repeatedly recovering these quantities from raw images introduces both reasoning uncertainty and additional computational cost: metric and structural relations remain challenging for vision-language models, whereas explicitly representing spatial information in text can improve reasoning reliability [ 21 , 15 , 18 , 23 ] .
Moreover, visual tokens often carry redundancy, incurring unnecessary overhead during reasoning [ 2 ] .
This raises a central question: does a robot agent need to reinterpret the visual scene at every decision step?
blocks.zh:
近期的前沿多式模型已经显示出日益强大的三维空间推理,在某些情况下,在没有针对具体任务的政策培训的情况下,可以直接推动机器人操纵[24,10,19,17].
然而,在闭路操纵中部署这种模型,往往需要随着场景的演进而反复地重新解释视觉观测,尽管许多操纵决定是由一组紧凑的与任务相关的几何量[14,26]所决定的.
从原始图像中反复取回这些数量,既带来了推理不确定性,也带来了额外的计算成本:对于视觉语言模型来说,衡量和结构关系仍然具有挑战性,而在文本中明确体现空间信息可以提高推理的可靠性[21、15、18、23]。
此外,视觉标志往往带有冗余性,在推理过程中造成不必要的间接费用[2].
这提出了一个中心问题:机器人特工是否需要在每个决策步骤上重新解释视觉场景?

blocks.en: Existing interfaces trade off richness and compactness. Raw images retain detailed scene information but require repeated visual interpretation, while conventional perception APIs often expose only coarse object-level quantities such as centers or bounding boxes. ReKep [ 7 ] shows that explicit 3D keypoints and relational constraints can provide an effective interface for manipulation. Meanwhile, language-model-based robotics is moving toward persistent and structured policies: Code as Policies [ 12 ] synthesizes executable programs, ASPIRE [ 13 ] extends this paradigm through execution–diagnosis–repair and skill reuse, and Graph-as-Policy [ 1 ] represents policies as modular graphs. These works make the policy itself structured and reusable, raising a complementary question: what representation of the 3D physical scene should such policies reason over?
blocks.zh: 现有的接口交换了丰富和紧凑。 原始图像保留了详细的场景信息,但需要反复的可视化解释,而常规感知API往往只暴露出粗糙的物体级数量,如中心或边框等. ReKep [ 7]显示,明确的3D关键点和关系限制可以为操纵提供有效的接口. 同时,基于语言模式的机器人正在走向持续和结构化的政策: 代码作为 Policy [12] 合成可执行程序, ASPIRE [13] 通过执行 - 诊断 - 修复 - 技能再利用来扩展这个范式, Graph-as- Policy [1] 代表政策作为模块图. 这些工作使政策本身结构化和可重复使用,提出了一个补充性的问题:这些政策应该说明3D物理场景的什么代表?

blocks.en: To address this question, we propose shifting routine spatial reasoning from images to text and symbols through an explicit 3D geometric abstraction (Fig. 1 ). Rather than reducing objects to single 3D centroids or vague natural-language descriptions, our abstraction models scene geometry as a structured set of typed 3D object parts—including centers, vertices, edges, and oriented surfaces—annotated with timestamps and evidence status ( observed , inferred from shape priors, or unavailable under occlusion). Local perception grounds this 3D state from calibrated RGB-D and exposes it to the language model in two forms. First, symbolic references (e.g., red.bottom_face , blue.top_face ) and geometric operators (such as surface alignment and support checks) let policies compose actions independently of specific object coordinates. Second, compact textual checkpoints report updated 3D coordinates, metric goal residuals, and evidence status after each action. Separating reusable symbolic structure from scene-dependent metric grounding lets the language model reason directly in text and symbols, invoking visual reasoning on demand when richer scene context is needed.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这一问题,我们建议通过明确的三维几何抽象(图1),将常规空间推理从图像转向文字和符号。 我们的抽象模型是一套结构化的三维物体部件——包括中心、顶点、边缘和外向表面——附加了时间戳和证据状况(观察、从形状前作推断,或在隐蔽下无法使用)。 本地感知从校正的RGB-D来证明这种3D状态,并以两种形式将其暴露于语言模型. 首先,符号引用(如:red.bottom_face, Blue.top_face)和几何操作符(如表面对齐和支持检查)让策略独立于特定对象坐标来组成动作. 第二,紧凑的文字检查站报告更新了3D坐标、指标目标剩余值以及每次行动后的证据状况。 将可重复使用的符号结构从基于场景的度量定位中分离出来,让语言模型在需要更丰富的场景上下文时直接用文字和符号来解释,在需求时引用可视推理.

blocks.en: We study this textual and symbolic 3D interface in two regimes. In policy synthesis , the language model revises an executable policy between rollouts using execution feedback, while geometric grounding and control run locally during rollouts. In online execution , the agent repeatedly reasons and selects skills within a single continuing episode using the updated textual checkpoint after each action, without resetting the scene after failures. Both settings use matched sensors, actuators, and initial skills. Across both regimes, our experiments show that reasoning over grounded text and symbols accelerates policy acquisition, substantially improves multi-step online construction completion, and reduces repeated multimodal queries and interaction latency. We use these two settings to examine when explicit textual and symbolic 3D state is sufficient for manipulation and when direct visual reasoning remains necessary.
blocks.zh: 我们在两种制度中研究这种文字和象征性的三维界面。 在政策综合中,语言模型在推出之间使用执行反馈修订可执行政策,而几何定位和控制则在推出期间在当地运行。 在在线执行中,代理多次在单个连续剧集中说明理由并选择技能,每次动作后使用更新的文字检查点,而不在失败后重设场景. 两个设置都使用相匹配的传感器,起动器,以及初始技能. 我们的实验表明,在这两种制度中,对基于基础的文本和符号的推理加快了政策获取,大大改进了多步骤在线建设的完成,并减少了重复的多式联运查询和互动的延迟。 我们利用这两种设置来检查何时明确的文字和象征性的3D状态足以被操纵,何时仍然需要直接的视觉推理.

blocks.en:
Our contributions are threefold: (i) we formulate a 3D geometric abstraction that
exposes task-relevant scene geometry to language models as structured text and symbols—combining typed, evidence-aware part references with reusable symbolic structure and local metric grounding;
(ii) we instantiate this abstraction as a reasoning-to-action interface with composable geometric
operators, local RGB-D grounding, and compact textual checkpoints; and (iii) we
empirically evaluate the interface across policy synthesis and continuous online execution,
characterizing its impact on manipulation completion, model interaction cost, and the
remaining role of direct visual input.
blocks.zh:
我们的贡献有三个:(一) 我们提出一个三维几何抽象,
将与任务相关的场景几何作为结构化的文字和符号——与可重复使用的符号结构以及局部度量定位相结合的、有证据意识的部分参考;
(二)我们即时将这个抽象作为推理-动作界面与可相容几何
(三) 我们
实证地评价政策综合和连续在线执行之间的接口,
描述其对操作完成、模型交互成本和
直接视觉输入的剩余作用。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Prior work bridges high-level reasoning and low-level robot control through structured intermediate representations. VoxPoser [ 8 ] synthesizes composable 3D value maps for motion planning, ReKep [ 7 ] formulates manipulation as relational constraints over sparse 3D keypoints, and KALM [ 3 ] , RT-Affordance [ 14 ] , and ATK [ 26 ] extract task-driven keypoints or affordances to guide policy learning. Meanwhile, recent VLM evaluations show that recovering metric and structural 3D relations directly from images remains error-prone and token-intensive, whereas making spatial relations explicit in text improves reasoning reliability [ 21 , 15 , 18 , 23 , 2 ] . Rather than optimizing a single-step spatial objective or relying on coarse centroids, we maintain a persistent, evidence-aware 3D scene state of typed object parts (centers, vertices, edges, and oriented faces) that is continuously re-grounded from RGB-D and exposed to the language model as composable symbols and compact text.
blocks.zh: 之前的工作通过结构化的中间表示来连接高层次推理和低层次机器人控制. VoxPoser [8] 合成了可相容的3D值图用于运动规划,ReKep [7] 将操控作为关系限制于稀少的3D关键点,而KALM [3],RT-Afffordance [14],和ATK [26] 提取由任务驱动的键点或支付能力来指导政策学习. 同时,最近的VLM评价表明,直接从图像中恢复的公制和结构立体关系仍然容易出错并耗费大量文字,而文本中明确空间关系则能提高推理的可靠性[21、15、18、23、2]。 与其优化单步空间目标或依赖粗糙的中间体,不如保持被打入的物体部分(中心,顶点,边缘,并面向面相)的持久,有证据意识的3D场景状态,连续地从RGB-D重新定位,并暴露在语言模型中,成为可相容的符号和紧凑的文本.

blocks.en: Code as Policies [ 12 ] and Inner Monologue [ 9 ] pioneered composing perception-control APIs in code and incorporating closed-loop language feedback. Recent agentic frameworks extend this paradigm through coding-agent benchmarks and VLM module orchestration [ 5 , 16 ] , modular policy graphs and evolving skill libraries [ 1 , 4 ] , execution-driven repair in simulation and the real world [ 13 , 22 ] , and hierarchical VLA steering and failure correction [ 25 , 6 , 11 ] . While these works focus on how policies are synthesized, orchestrated, or repaired, we focus on the spatial state interface that closes the loop: re-grounding symbolic references after each action and returning metric goal residuals and evidence status in text so subsequent decisions reason over the observed post-action scene rather than assumed action outcomes.
blocks.zh: 代码为Policy [12]和Inner Monologue [9] 率先将感知控制API编成代码并包含闭路语言反馈. 近期的代理框架通过编码代理基准和VLM模块编组[5,16],模块化政策图和不断发展的技能库[1,4],模拟和现实世界中由执行驱动的修复[13,22],分级VLA引导和故障校正[25,6,11]来扩展这一范式. 虽然这些工作侧重于如何综合、协调或修复政策,但我们侧重于关闭循环的空间状态界面:在每次行动之后重新确定象征性的参考依据,并返回文字中的衡量目标剩余部分和证据状况,因此,随后的决定对观察到的后行动场景而不是假定行动结果有理。

blocks.en: 3.3 Textual checkpoints for reasoning
blocks.zh: 3.3 用于推理的文字检查站

blocks.en: Symbolic references support action composition, while textual checkpoints expose the current state in a compact form for reasoning. For active object i i and target position g i g_{i} , we write x t = Ψ ⁡ ( 𝒵 t , i , g i ) , e t = g i − p i ​ ( t ) , x_{t}=\Psi(\mathcal{Z}_{t},i,g_{i}),\qquad e_{t}=g_{i}-p_{i}(t), (4) where x t x_{t} summarizes the relevant current geometry, its evidence status, and the residual e t e_{t} between g i g_{i} and the current position p i ​ ( t ) p_{i}(t) of the selected reference. For example, after placing a block, the checkpoint reports whether the target face is aligned, the remaining translational displacement, and whether the current estimate is visually supported. If the object becomes occluded, the goal is retained but the residual is explicitly marked unavailable rather than computed from a stale pose estimate.

blocks.en: 3.4 Policy synthesis and online execution

blocks.en:
We evaluate the same interface in two operational regimes. In policy synthesis (single-policy acquisition), the
language model revises an executable program between batches of rollouts; within
each rollout, geometry is grounded locally and the program executes without
further language-model calls.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments

blocks.en:
We evaluate the geometric abstraction in simulation with an SO-100 robot arm
equipped with calibrated side and wrist RGB-D cameras. Across all experiments,
the agent receives the same task specification, sensor access, actuator interface, and
initial skills; no simulator object poses or private evaluator state are exposed.
We compare a Pixel Reasoning agent that reasons directly from visual observations with a Geometric Abstraction agent that additionally receives our grounded geometric references and
textual checkpoints. We study the interface in two regimes: policy synthesis
across repeated rollouts and continuous online execution within a single,
non-resetting episode.

blocks.en: In the policy synthesis regime, we test whether geometric abstraction helps an LLM acquire effective single-program policies within a small revision budget. The simulated SO-100 performs three manipulation tasks with randomized object poses and colors (Figure 3 ): Bridge+cylinder (placing two base blocks, spanning them with a beam, and placing an upright cylinder on top), Three-cube stacking (assembling a three-cube tower in a prescribed color order), and Ring-on-peg (grasping a hexagonal ring and threading it onto a vertical peg).
blocks.zh: 在政策综合制度中,我们检验几何抽象是否有助于LLM在小的修订预算中获得有效的单一方案政策. 模拟的SO-100执行三个有随机物体外观和颜色的操纵任务(图3): Bridge+圆柱(将两个基块插上,并用横梁横穿它们,并在上面放上一个正圆柱), 三立方体堆放(按规定的颜色顺序组装一出三立方体塔),而环相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相相相接相接相相相接相接相接相相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相相接相相相

blocks.en: Pixel Reasoning and Geometric Abstraction share the task specification, calibrated RGB-D access, and action interface, both using gpt-6-astra with high reasoning effort. Pixel Reasoning implements custom perception routines directly in its generated program, whereas Geometric Abstraction additionally queries sensor-grounded 3D part references, geometric operators, and textual checkpoints. Neither condition has access to simulator ground-truth poses or private evaluator state.
blocks.zh: 像素理性和几何抽象分享任务规格,校正RGB-D访问,以及动作界面,两者都使用gpt-6-astra并有高推理努力. Pixel Reasoning在其生成的程序中直接执行自定义感知常规,而"几何摘要"则额外查询了以传感器为底的3D部分参考文献,几何操作符和文字检查站. 这两种条件都无法进入模拟地面实况或私人评估状态。

blocks.en: For each task, we run five paired training chains over five shared training layouts with separate persistent LLM contexts. Starting from an observation-only scaffold (R0), the LLM generates three policy revisions (R1–R3). Each revision executes across all five training layouts with a scene reset between rollouts and no LLM calls during execution; rollout outcomes and observations inform the subsequent revision. A candidate policy is retained only if it succeeds on every previously solved training layout plus at least one additional layout; otherwise, the incumbent policy is kept. After training freezes, each retained version is evaluated on 100 shared held-out layouts per task without further revision. Physical success requires achieving the target arrangement, releasing the object, and maintaining stability (Figure 4 ; Table 2 in Appendix A ).
blocks.zh: 针对每项任务,我们运行了5个对接的培训链,在5个共享的培训布局上,有不同的长期长期长期长期学习的内容。 从只观测脚手架(R0)开始,LLM产生三次政策修改(R1-R3). 每次修订在所有五个培训布局中执行,在执行期间在推出和无LLM呼叫之间重新设置一个场景;推出结果和观察为随后的修订提供信息。 候选人政策只有在每项先前解决的培训布局上取得成功,再加上至少增加一个布局的情况下才能保留;否则,现行政策得到保留。 在培训被冻结后,每个保留版本都按每项任务的100个共享搁置布局进行评价,不再作进一步修订。 实际成功需要达到目标安排,释放对象并保持稳定性(图4;附录A表2)。

blocks.en: Geometric abstraction substantially accelerates policy acquisition on both construction tasks. The largest gap appears at the first revision (R1), where Geometric Abstraction reaches 45.2 % 45.2\% held-out test SR on Bridge+cylinder (vs. 21.2 % 21.2\% for Pixel Reasoning) and 57.2 % 57.2\% on Three-cube stacking (vs. 17.2 % 17.2\% ). By R2, Geometric Abstraction’s mean test SR ( 63.4 % 63.4\% and 72.2 % 72.2\% ) already surpasses Pixel Reasoning’s final R3 performance ( 56.0 % 56.0\% and 70.8 % 70.8\% ) on both tasks, while expending roughly half the cumulative tokens ( 67.3 ​ k 67.3\text{k} vs. 125.7 ​ k 125.7\text{k} on Bridge+cylinder; 64.7 ​ k 64.7\text{k} vs. 138.1 ​ k 138.1\text{k} on Stacking). Although the gap narrows at R3 as Pixel Reasoning refines its perception code, Geometric Abstraction retains higher final success ( 65.4 % 65.4\% and 81.4 % 81.4\% ) and lower chain-to-chain variance, with comparable total tokens on Bridge+cylinder and lower token usage on Stacking. Ring-on-peg follows a different pattern: both conditions remain at 0.0 % 0.0\% retained test SR through R2, before Geometric Abstraction reaches 38.0 % 38.0\% at R3 while Pixel Reasoning remains at 0.0 % 0.0\% . Here, geometric abstraction enables successful policy acquisition within the three-revision budget where image-only synthesis fails to converge, as fine ring-to-peg alignment benefits directly from grounded part references. Note that these gains reflect the combined effect of policy synthesis and local geometric grounding during execution, rather than isolating LLM inference speed or text formatting alone.

blocks.en: We next evaluate whether geometric abstraction helps an LLM ( gpt-6-astra , medium reasoning effort) orchestrate prior skills and recover from failures online under a real-time wall-clock budget (Figure 5 ). Failed actions are not reset, so model waiting time shares the same 200-second episode budget as physical execution and recovery.

blocks.en: We evaluate 50 paired layouts per task (300 episodes total) across three tasks: Bridge-tower (stacking two cubes atop a constructed bridge), Ring-on-peg (aligning and releasing a pre-lifted ring over a peg), and Tower relocation (transferring the upper two cubes of a column onto a new foundation while preserving order and foundation poses). Both conditions share identical local skills (bridge/stacking primitives, a shared sensor-driven ring grasp-and-lift prefix, and placement routines) and can request camera images and depth samples on demand; Geometric Abstraction additionally receives compact textual checkpoints and symbolic references after each action. Each episode runs continuously for up to 200 s with physics advancing during model waits (see Appendix B – C for full protocol and audited repeat details).

blocks.en: Geometric Abstraction substantially increases completion rates on multi-step construction, solving Bridge-tower on 28/50 layouts (56% vs. 12/50, 24%) and Tower relocation on 42/50 layouts (84% vs. 15/50, 30%) with lower mean capped completion times (Figure 6 ; Table 3 in Appendix B ). On Ring-on-peg, where both conditions reliably succeed (50/50 vs. 49/50), Geometric Abstraction finishes 33.3% faster (77.2 s vs. 115.8 s), completing earlier on 45 of 50 pairs.

blocks.en: Simultaneously, Geometric Abstraction reduces repeated multimodal querying (Figure 7 ). On Ring-on-peg, model-request time drops by 49.4% (45.6 s vs. 90.0 s), recorded tokens by 52.8% (101.3k vs. 214.5k), completed requests from 11.88 to 6.90, and attached images from 10.94 to 2.72. Tower relocation shows a 60.5% reduction in model time and 52.5% in tokens while physical execution time remains similar (104.5 s vs. 103.2 s). On Bridge-tower, Geometric Abstraction more than doubles completion with 6.7% less model time and 15.1% more tokens, showing that the interface improves performance both by cutting visual query overhead and by enabling effective corrective actions within the time budget. Across all tasks, local RGB-D sensing refreshes the 3D state while drastically reducing image attachments to the LLM (Table 3 ; Figure 8 ).
blocks.zh: 同时,几何抽象减少了重复的多式查询(图7)。 在Ring-on-peg上,模型-请求时间下降49.4%(45.6 s vs. 90.0 s),收录了52.8%(101.3k vs. 214.5k)的代币,完成11.88到6.90的请求,并附上了10.94到2.72的图像. 塔的搬迁显示模型时间减少了60.5%,信使减少了52.5%,而实际执行时间仍然相似(104.5s对103.2s)。 Bridge-tower上,"几何抽象"比完成多出一倍多,模型时间少了6.7%,符号多出15.1%,表明界面通过削减视觉查询间接费用和在时间预算内促成有效的纠正行动,提高了性能. 在所有任务中,局部的RGB-D感知刷新了3D状态,同时大幅度地将图像附件减少为LLM(表3;图8 ).

blocks.en: 5 Limitations and Discussion
blocks.zh: 5. 限制和讨论

blocks.en:
Our evaluation focuses on simulated table-top manipulation with regular
object geometries. Real-world deployment remains an essential next step to assess robustness
under realistic sensor noise, heavy occlusion, and camera calibration drift. We deliberately used
lightweight CPU-based geometric estimators to keep local grounding fast and self-contained, leaving learned 3D perception modules
and articulated or deformable objects for future work.
blocks.zh:
我们评价的重点是定期模拟桌面操作
对象几何。 现实世界的部署仍然是评估稳健性的下一个重要步骤
在现实感应噪声, 重隐蔽,和相机校正漂移。 我们故意利用
基于CPU的轻量级几何估计器,以保持局部地基快速自成一体,留下所学的3D感知模块
以及未来工作的明确或可变形对象。

blocks.en:
In continuous online execution, geometric abstraction reduced decision rounds and on-demand image
attachments across tasks, indicating that its primary benefit lies in providing direct, actionable spatial state
throughout the reasoning–action loop rather than merely compressing prompt length. More concise checkpoint schemas and learned
symbolic abstractions could further reduce interaction overhead. For novel object categories,
VLM-assisted shape initialization could broaden coverage, provided its one-time grounding cost is
accounted for alongside policy execution and amortized across subsequent interactions.
blocks.zh:
在连续的在线执行中,几何抽象减少了决策回合和点播图像
说明其主要好处在于提供可采取行动的直接空间状态
– 整个推理 - 动作循环,而不是仅仅压缩即时长度. 更简洁的检查站计划和经验
象征性抽象可能进一步减少交互性间接费用。 对于小说对象类别,
VLM协助的形状初始化可以扩大覆盖面,只要其一次性地基成本
与政策执行并列,并分期摊还随后的相互作用。

blocks.en:
Finally, decoupling local visual grounding from high-level policy reasoning opens the possibility of driving manipulation with fast text-only language models.
By exposing verified, sensor-grounded 3D state in text, the interface allows a language model to reason over physical geometry without processing dense visual tokens at every step.
Evaluating diverse models on standardized geometric checkpoints could clarify
how effectively language models perform spatial reasoning when metric relations are made explicit,
and help delineate which manipulation decisions are well served by structured geometric state versus direct visual inspection.
blocks.zh:
最后,将本地视觉定位与高层次的政策推理脱钩,为用快速的文本唯一语言模式来驱动操纵提供了可能性.
通过在文本中曝光经核实的,感官地基的3D状态,界面允许语言模型在物理几何之上进行理性分析,而不在每个步骤上处理密集的视觉符号.
评价标准化几何检查站的各种模式可以澄清
在明确衡量关系时,语言模型如何有效地进行空间推理,
并且通过结构化几何状态与直接的视觉检查,帮助划分哪些操纵决定是很好的。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We investigated whether agentic robot policies need to reinterpret visual observations at every
decision step. Across both offline policy synthesis and continuous online execution, our results
demonstrate that maintaining an explicit geometric abstraction improves manipulation completion while
substantially reducing repeated multimodal queries. By pairing reusable symbolic references with
metric values refreshed from local RGB-D observations, the interface allows visual sensing to remain
continuously active in the control loop without requiring the language model to process images at every
step—positioning structured geometric state as a practical substrate for agentic reasoning
and action, with direct visual reasoning invoked on demand.

blocks.en:
The geometric abstraction converts calibrated RGB-D observations into metric entities, symbolic
references, and compact textual checkpoints. It runs locally on the CPU using fixed geometric estimators
throughout both policy synthesis and online execution.

参考文献和紧凑的文字检查站。 它使用固定的几何图形在CPU上运行
包括政策综合和在线执行。

blocks.en:
Symbolic references such as red.top_face resolve to typed geometric primitives: points, axes, or
oriented faces with centers and outward normals. Each record stores world-frame coordinates, physical units,
observation timestamps, and evidence status ( observed , inferred , or unavailable ). Initialized shape dimensions
persist across an episode, whereas a movable object’s pose must be refreshed from current visual evidence after movement.
For partially occluded rings, initialized boundary templates are registered to currently
visible contour edges; underconstrained or ambiguous fits return unavailable . Unobserved object
faces retain model-derived labels marked as inferred, while the stationary peg may retain an earlier
verified measurement with its original timestamp. Geometric support predicates report metric
residuals and missing evidence rather than certifying physical contact or dynamic stability.

blocks.en:
The Geometric Abstraction agent receives task-relevant object geometry, symbolic references, evidence metadata, and
requested goal residuals formatted as structured text (with dense boundary point arrays omitted from online
Ring-on-peg checkpoints for compactness). Multiple geometric queries can reuse a single RGB-D capture, and local sensing
can refresh the geometric state after an action without attaching new images to the LLM prompt. Initial and
on-demand camera images remain accessible whenever visual inspection is requested. In policy synthesis, generated programs invoke geometric operators
locally during rollouts; in online execution, the agent reads updated textual checkpoints to select its next skill or recovery action.
